The main takeaway from our work is that

the current context of English education is not one that supports schools in making changes in grouping practice, and that the current policy environment is not one that is supportive of mixed attainment practice.

the low uptake of mixed attainment practice is not simply due to a lack of knowledge or a fear of the unknown, but rather a result of the way in which mixed attainment teaching practice is positioned in the educational landscape.
